verdict.rationale: ClickUp's homepage claims a first-party "Build your own agent" capability alongside prebuilt agents like Super Agent, Codegen Agent and Triage Agent, so the capability is the product's own. However, the evidence is a single marketing line with no documentation of how agents are built or configured. missing for 10: documentation of the agent builder, configuration options (instructions, tools, triggers, knowledge sources, permissions), any setup walkthrough, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build and configure my own custom AI agent within the product
